description: This Java class, ExportSchema, is a test utility that generates an SQL schema script from JPA annotated POJOs using Hibernate. It is designed for schema creation and export operations within the test environment.

classes.name: ExportSchema
classes.description: A test class extending AbstractSalesManagerCoreTestCase, used to generate database schema scripts from JPA entities.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates an SQL schema script file ('c:/schema.sql') from annotated POJOs by configuring Hibernate and exporting the schema. It is a JUnit test method annotated with @Test and @Ignore, indicating it's a test utility not run by default.
